visualReview.notes: Inspected 74 current frames in one author/inspect/fix pass: 14 portable, 14 shared, 30 medium-fi and 16 native. Full curved Tottori approach, unequal road grades and crest, five-span rigid-frame silhouette, deep tapered girders, full-height oval main piers, every approach pier, opposite maintenance bays, footways and open rails remain. The previous automatic skyline had 348.35m reported error; all four current browser models are authored from the original alignment/profile. Added skyline stations where actual mesh rays caught excessive central intrados interpolation. Detailed source (814362 triangles, 60454680 bytes) and canonical runtime remain byte-exact.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Two existing 256px shared graphs, concrete_plain and metal_painted, supply reusable concrete grain and painted fittings with metric UVs. Runtime roadway and markings also bind these graphs using restrained component tints. Near transparent blue bay screens use a small local PBR glazing material with no texture image; source master preserves its existing palette roadway/marking materials. No private texture atlas, embedded images or copied photographic pixels. Textured LODs use two/three draws and read each shared graph once; skyline bakes shared means into one vertex-color draw. Separate GPU streams and full geometry disposal pass.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs: 980/3470/15764/58116 triangles. Initial skyline + district 441352 bytes; closeup 5717412 bytes. Skyline omits narrow lamps and uses coarse pier sections; district uses representative lamps. Street/closeup retain source lamp rhythm, raised footways and transparent supported bay screens; posts use12m/2m spacing. Fine infill, form ties, grate bars, comb teeth and navigation lettering remain in the master. Japanese procedural neighbors, economy/high, noon/late, silhouette and all four transitions were inspected. Physical laptop/phone timings remain pending.

runtimePreservation.notes: All 644 resident / 786 wider mapped buildings, 450 independent transportation records, every original DEM sample and native water/shoreline behavior remain. Only the mapped crossing and its two directly shared outward road approaches receive clipping/height hints. Unrelated fragments sharing the same tile feature IDs remain exact. Failed load retains the original procedural crossing without supports; unload releases all model/support geometry and restores native content. Fixture/engine hashes are pinned. Curved endpoint support also passes41 targeted Earth tests (rotation, nonuniform scale, malformed endpoints and existing bridge behavior); affected package typecheck and seven-file formatter check pass. Full engine CI was not rerun; previously recorded livery-schema failures remain outside this model pass.

limitations: Original detailed exterior reconstruction, not fabrication geometry. Measured span and section dimensions constrain the structural silhouette; crest transition and small fittings are reconstructed.
The bridge is modeled in its operating form. Temporary work platforms, construction machinery, buried foundation caissons, underwater piers and adjoining roads beyond the1446.2m bridge are omitted.
Nakaumi water elevation is provisionally0m in the viewer; source tourist height is treated as road crest and is not a surveyed absolute vertical datum.
Maintenance bay side/length, lamps, drain hardware, rail infill spacing, asphalt color and minor weathering follow available photographs rather than a current inspection inventory.
Detailed source master is retained byte-exact; all four runtime representations are authored independently on the source alignment and height profile.

Skyline retains every approach pier with coarse cross-sections. District uses representative lamps and a continuous open top rail. Near levels retain both footways, source lamp rhythm, transparent bay screens and supporting ribs.
Street posts are spaced 12m; closeup 2m. Fine 0.2m infill, form ties, drain gratings, navigation lettering and comb teeth stay in the detailed master.
Standard PMTiles/Mapzen and ordinary photos guide placement; end grades and lake water zero remain approximate. Physical device timings remain pending.
